# John & Co. Heritage Farms & Landholdings LLC

> Veteran-led South Carolina company formed in October 2026, based in Upstate South Carolina (Anderson County). Developing agricultural sourcing and distribution, producer and processing relationships, and land and property services (in development; not yet operating).

Founder: Alex Dalton (Johnathan Alexander Dalton), U.S. Marine Corps veteran, Clemson University graduate, author of Warrior's Light: A Memoir of Faith, Fire & the American Soul.
Contact: daltonalex59@gmail.com · 864-933-9965.
Not claimed: government registration or certification, contract awards, land ownership, or securities offerings.
